name: @feitio/vanilla
description: Feitio's component behaviors in plain JavaScript, for any HTML: the timed Notice, and more to come.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/notice/index.ts src/menu/index.ts src/forms/index.ts src/status/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --entry-naming [dir]/[name].[ext] --root src && bun run rename
scripts.rename: mv dist/index.js dist/feitio.js && for m in notice menu forms status; do mv dist/$m/index.js dist/$m.js && rmdir dist/$m; done
